claim_text: Natural vitamin B12 is found in animal-source foods; some plant foods contain B12 only when fortified. A vegan dietary pattern therefore requires a reliable B12 source from fortified foods or supplements.
health_goal_or_outcome: Assess whether dietary pattern provides a reliable vitamin B12 source.

population.age_range: Not limited to a single age group; apply life-stage-specific reference values separately.
population.health_status: General dietary context; not a diagnosis of deficiency.
population.other_context: Vegan dietary pattern and fortified-food intake.

ingredient_form_or_preparation: Vitamin B12 from animal-source foods, fortified foods, or supplements; source/form-specific dose equivalence not inferred.
comparator: Dietary patterns with reliable B12-containing foods versus vegan pattern without reliable fortified foods or supplements.
evidence_summary: The existing NIH ODS B12 Health Professional source is the source reference already used by the repository's B12 deep record and draft vegan-context rule. The statement is retained as a draft claim pending source-specific extraction and human review.
limitations: Does not select a supplement form or individualized dose.
Does not replace assessment of malabsorption, medications, laboratory findings or life-stage needs.
